name: 08809 · Clinton, NJ
findings: ZIP 08809 (Clinton) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08809 (Clinton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08809 (Clinton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
